---
title: "Methods and data"
---

## Data sources

| Source | Used for | Latency |
|---|---|---|
| [City of Flagstaff ALERT network](https://rain.flagstaffaz.gov/jefmap/) | Event detection, rain totals and timing across ~40 gauges | Minutes |
| [NRCS SNOTEL](https://www.nrcs.usda.gov/wps/portal/wcc/home/) (Fort Valley, Snowslide Canyon, Fry) | Snow water equivalent, snow depth, precipitation, temperature | Daily |
| NWS Flagstaff Pulliam Airport via [RCC-ACIS](https://www.rcc-acis.org/) | Monthly temperature and precipitation, 1991–2020 normals | About 1 day |
| [ERA5](https://cds.climate.copernicus.eu/) (Copernicus Climate Change Service) | Moisture transport, 250-hPa wind, 500-hPa height | About 5 days |
| [NHC best track](https://ftp.nhc.noaa.gov/atcf/btk/) | Tropical cyclone positions | Hours (operational; final after season) |

## Definitions

- **IVT (integrated vapour transport):** the magnitude of the vertically integrated water-vapour flux, in kg m⁻¹ s⁻¹, from ERA5's eastward and northward components.
- **Atmospheric-river conditions:** IVT ≥ 250 kg m⁻¹ s⁻¹.
- **Network rain:** the median and the 10th–90th percentile range across city gauges, so that no single gauge stands in for the city.
- **Provisional / final:** event pages are provisional until ERA5 covers the event (about 5 days after it ends).
